title: A great overview of the history of the Cathedral
text: This was a walking and listening on an ear piece tour of the Cathedral and the tower. We got to go to the top of the tower. Well worth the effort. Also it was very informative of the various periods of history of the cathedral.
author: Marie_L

title: 100 % approved
text: Our guide was just the best. She knew everything and had an answear to every question. She had tons of energy and was full of optimism & joy. It was really an amazing experience, made easy and very worhwile. I recommend. ✅
author: lid076

title: Best Tour of Cathedral and Gibraltar!!
text: Incredible tour with the most knowledgeable tour guide.   She was excellent, patient and very knowledgeable about the history of Seville Cathedral and Gibraltar.    We had enough time to visit both without exhaustion and the duration is just perfect!      Thank you for an amazing tour!
author: Maggie_R
